# Every %ghost path under /etc that is a regular file on the rhel-10.2 test host
# (state regular or empty), or that a package declares as a regular file and the
# host lacks (absent), with its package and rpm fflags. Measured 2026-11-21 with
# rpm -qa --queryformat '[%{=NAME} %{FILEFLAGS:fflags} %{FILENAMES}\n]', FILEMODES and stat.
# Symlinks and directories are left out: the ghost branch never reads them.
